offlineProtection.explainerLead: During service you must keep the dashboard or kitchen screen on and connected.
offlineProtection.explainerBody: If the screen turns off, the device loses internet or you switch to another website, offline protection kicks in: it pauses orders or turns off auto-accept, depending on what you chose.
offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ During service, keep the dashboard or kitchen screen on and connected, or offline protection will kick in.
offlineProtection.enableConfirm:
Offline protection has been turned on.

For orders to keep arriving, the screen must be on. If this device loses connection, offline protection kicks in in the mode you chose.

Make sure “Screen on” is turned on on this device.
offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Do you want to turn off offline protection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders will keep arriving: customers could place orders you will not see. Turn it off only if you have a reliable connection.
offlineProtection.cardDescription: Decides what happens to orders arriving when the device goes offline.
offlineProtection.purpose: If the device loses connection, this stops orders arriving while you cannot see them.
offlineProtection.switchHelp: What happens when this vehicle loses connection.
offlineProtection.modes.pause.label: Pause online orders
offlineProtection.modes.pause.help: Customers cannot order until you have a connection again.
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.l: Keep receiving orders and confirm them yourself
offlineProtection.modes.no_auto_accept.h: Auto-accept is turned off: customers can keep ordering, but nothing is confirmed automatically. You will confirm them one by one when you have a connection again, and any still pending are rejected automatically after the time you chose, and the customer is sent an email to let them know.
kitchenCapacity.desc: The most items your kitchen can turn out at once, adding up all the categories you have ticked. On top of that, each category’s batch size still applies.
kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 main dishes in 5 minutes, set 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders from all selected categories; so if you only want to sell at most 10 starters and main dishes every 5 minutes, set total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Main dishes boxes. That way main dishes stay limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
kitchenCapacity.noLimit: Leave the infinity symbol to set no limit.
kitchenCapacity.warning: ⚠️ For kitchen capacity to work well, set a prep time and a batch size on your menu categories (Menu & Stock). Without this data, capacity cannot know how long the items take to cook.
kitchenCapacity.noVan: Add a vehicle in Settings › Vehicle settings to set up kitchen capacity.
kitchenCapacity.lead: How many items your kitchen can make, so customers can only choose collection times you can meet.

settingsCopy.autoAccept.label: Automatic order acceptance
settingsCopy.autoAccept.help: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next available slot. It is only confirmed if there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) will still have to be confirmed.
settingsCopy.orderReady.label: “Ready” step
settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens are set up separately, on each device. Customers get an email every time an order is marked as ready. Applies to all events: you can turn it on or off for a single event from its dashboard.
